objective: Complete the Oasis Baklawa Appverse. PR completion is subordinate to application completion.

status_vocabulary.CLEARED: Completed and verified against every mandatory gate for the stated scope.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed until a named dependency or blocker clears.
status_vocabulary.READY: Prerequisites are clear and work may start.
status_vocabulary.NOT_CLEARED: Known remaining work or clearance evidence is incomplete.
status_vocabulary.LOCKED: Deliberately cannot begin until upstream programme gates clear.

clearance_rule: A merged PR is evidence only. It MUST NOT automatically set a stage or substage to CLEARED. CLEARED requires every mandatory gate declared for that item.

current_mission.mission: Final cross-repository dependency control, exact completion sequencing and fail-closed convergence to Point100/production readiness.
current_mission.stop_condition: The dependency graph and its CI invariants are green; every active completion lane is routed to its owning repository; final completion remains locked only on explicit software review/release and external production/physical/provider gates.

production_safety_gate.rule: Mission Control may prepare and validate non-production governance changes. Protected production merges, production migrations/deployments/data/config mutation, billable infrastructure creation and physical/provider evidence require the separately governed authorization/evidence of the owning lane.

dependency_graph.rule: Cross-repository dependencies are semantic/release edges and Git branch bases remain repository-local. All current final feature/security PRs target main; no stacked PR exception remains.

critical_path.current_primary_blocker: No single universal blocker. Final completion now converges through Core/Central AUTH-01, Central governance/Point55/AI caller, Core Finance/Trace/security/WhatsApp/AI-chat release lanes, AI Studio Point50/51/session security, Buyer recertification, Trace #38, Point100, then physical/provider and production-readiness gates.
